BindingCeiling.description:
Which bound held a proposal's confidence down.

Recorded rather than derived on read so a reviewer can see *why* a proposal
is not more confident. ``NONE`` means the raw signal score was itself the
limit — the evidence supported more confidence than the signals produced.
BindingCeiling.title: BindingCeiling

CatalogSummaryResponse.description:
What this Organization can actually be asked about.

Replaces the fixed list of governed scenarios (ADR-0023). A client that has
to offer the user a starting question needs the Organization's own vocabulary,
and this is the same governed catalog the Cube Analyst reasons over — so a
suggestion the UI makes is one the agent can genuinely answer.
CatalogSummaryResponse.title: CatalogSummaryResponse

examples.message: Why did EU refunds increase from June to July 2026?

messages.content:
I could not map that message to a governed question. Please choose or rephrase one supported question.
- Why did EU refunds increase from June to July 2026?
- Which sales channel accounted for the increase in North America revenue from October to November 2026?

suggestions: Why did EU refunds increase from June to July 2026?
Which sales channel accounted for the increase in North America revenue from October to November 2026?

DeletionPreviewResponse.description: What deleting a source would destroy. Informs; does not gate.
DeletionPreviewResponse.title: DeletionPreviewResponse

DraftFindingResponse.description:
The Phase 2 structured draft.

Sits beside `finding` rather than replacing it. An Investigation that ran
before Insight existed has `finding` and a null `draft_finding`, which is
how a client tells a legacy narrative apart from claims that are genuinely
structured and will become individually citable.
DraftFindingResponse.title: DraftFindingResponse

EvidenceCitationResponse.description:
One validated measurement, addressable on its own.

The user-facing contract ADR 0011 asks for, in place of an opaque
`artifact://` pointer: what was measured, scoped how, by which execution,
and what the independent recheck made of it.
EvidenceCitationResponse.title: EvidenceCitationResponse

EvidenceDeletionRequest.description:
Deleting evidence is irreversible, so it is not a bare POST.

The caller states the Investigation it means. A confirmation the client can
default to would not be a confirmation.
EvidenceDeletionRequest.title: EvidenceDeletionRequest

FieldProfileResponse.description: Statistics, always accompanied by the size of the sample behind them.
FieldProfileResponse.title: FieldProfileResponse

HarvestPhase.description:
Where a Harvest Run has reached.

Ordered as they occur, so a reader can tell progress from the phase alone.
HarvestPhase.title: HarvestPhase

HarvestResponse.description: Progress as counts. A percentage of an unknown total would be a fiction.
HarvestResponse.title: HarvestResponse

RelationDecisionRequest.description:
Confirm or reject. A rejection must say why; a confirmation need not.

Asymmetric on purpose, and the same asymmetry the Investigation API already
uses for Human Approvals: the recorded reason is what suppresses
re-proposal, so a rejection without one would silently lose that behaviour.
RelationDecisionRequest.title: RelationDecisionRequest

RelationResponse.description: A Relation with the evidence a reviewer needs to disagree with it.
RelationResponse.title: RelationResponse

RelationState.description:
The lifecycle of a Relation.

``confirmed`` is the only state the Join Graph contains. Everything else
exists so the reviewer's decisions are remembered: ``rejected`` so the same
wrong guess is not re-proposed forever, ``stale`` so a schema change
withdraws a join rather than silently changing what it means.
RelationState.title: RelationState

SourceCredentialsRequest.description: Credentials on the way in. Write-only: nothing returns this shape.
SourceCredentialsRequest.title: SourceCredentialsRequest

SourceKind.description:
How a Data Source came to exist.

Two kinds of one concept rather than two concepts. An uploaded file is a
Data Source backed by a Nexus-owned table, which is what gives harvest,
profiling and inference exactly one implementation — and what makes
relations *across* sources fall out rather than needing separate machinery.
SourceKind.title: SourceKind

TableRowsResponse.description:
A page of raw rows from one Source Table, read straight through Cube.

Columns and rows are pre-shaped server-side, in the catalog's own field
order, so the frontend never has to reconcile Cube's `"table.field"`-keyed
row objects against a separately-fetched column list.
TableRowsResponse.title: TableRowsResponse

TombstoneResponse.description:
What a citation resolves to once its evidence was deliberately erased.

Identity, category, timestamp. `extra="forbid"` and the absence of every
other field are what stop a later change reintroducing the metric, the
period or the filters — a filter can carry customer values as readily as
an aggregate can.
TombstoneResponse.title: TombstoneResponse

get.description:
The governed vocabulary this Organization may ask questions about.

Resolved per Organization, so it is the Organization's own catalog and never
another's
— the whole reason `ScopedCubeSemanticLayers` exists. Measures and
dimensions only: no rows, and no physical schema.
The confirmed Relations, and the fields nothing connects to.

schema.title: Response List Relations V1 Connector Catalog Versions  Catalog Version Id  Relations Get
Response Search Catalog V1 Connector Catalog Versions  Catalog Version Id  Search Get

post.description:
Confirm or reject a proposal.

A rejection without a reason is refused here rather than defaulted, because
the reason is what stops the same wrong guess being re-proposed forever and
a default would silently pick one on the reviewer's behalf.

schema.title: Response List Sources V1 Connector Sources Get

get.description:
What DELETE would destroy, so it is known beforehand.

A read. Deletion itself stays unconditional — an Organization who wants their data
gone should not be argued with, only informed.

schema.title: Response List Harvests V1 Connector Sources  Data Source Id  Harvests Get

post.description:
Begin discovery and return something to watch.

202 rather than 200, and the work is scheduled after the response rather
than awaited: relation inference issues a query per candidate pair against
someone else's warehouse and will not finish inside a request.

Parse a file and show what it looks like, committing to nothing.

Preview before commit exists because a mis-parsed column discovered after
the fact has already poisoned every profile and every Relation below it.

get.description:
Follow one claim to the evidence behind it.

Nested under the Investigation so the Investigation's own visibility is
checked first: a citation id must not become a way to probe an
Investigation the caller cannot read.

There is no Organization parameter, here or anywhere below. Identity comes from
the verified token, so there is nothing for a caller to supply or override.

schema.title: Response Resolve Citation V1 Investigations  Investigation Id  Citations  Citation Id  Get

post.description:
Erase a terminal Investigation's evidence.

The body must name the Investigation the path already names. It is a
deliberate redundancy: an irreversible action should be impossible to
trigger by replaying a URL, and a confirmation the client can default to
would not be a confirmation.
